scope: Public synthetic radical unordered-pair membership and sparse chained-S3 polynomial solving. No unknown scalar and no complete ECDLP recovery.

algebraic_boundary.reason: The b(b+1)/2 monomials s^i t^j with i+j<=b-1 are an interpolation basis on P_W.
algebraic_boundary.success_condition: The radical image basis reaches ratio d_reg/b=1 while exact roots and recovery are preserved.

reference: Direct sparse pair tree S3(x1,x2,u)=S3(x3,x4,v)=S3(u,v,z)=0 on identical curves, factor bases, targets, solver version, thread count and resources.

primary_end_to_end_metrics.reason: This suite measures the polynomial-solver stage and does not include relation collection, relation-matrix work, individual logarithm extraction or a common-operation conversion.

correctness: Direct and symmetric finite root sets agree after quotient and recovery.
Recovered roots lie in the identical factor base.
Finite chain roots equal all nondegenerate elliptic-curve group relations.
Timeout, OOM and errors remain explicit.
stage_candidate: Radical max F4 degree is no larger than direct on every matched target.
Producing-target paired radical/direct wall ratio has a 95% bootstrap interval below 1 in the main and holdout b>=5 cells.
One-time preprocessing is included in cold batch ratios.
falsification: Any root-set, recovery or group-law mismatch rejects the candidate.
A larger F4 degree on a matched target rejects the algebraic solver-stage claim for that cell.
A cold batch ratio >=1 is retained as a negative result.
Failure to finish within 120 seconds is TIMEOUT, never UNSAT.

binary_cells.status: prior bounded run censored after 90 seconds; not rerun or promoted

runner.raw_log_mode: msolve -g 1 -v 2; leading ideal plus F4 protocol, without the expanded reduced basis body
runner.pair_order: rotated by cell, target and repetition

equivalent_suite_exception: The repository WDSat regression exercises the Rust Boolean Semaev solver and cannot execute Sage/msolve prime-field or radical image systems. This suite freezes matched direct/norm/radical systems under the parent accounting fields and reports only solver-stage diagnostics.
